notes: CXPalm 0.0.21 / build57: Clear unread markers across Web and Android after confirming the exact visible reply in the gateway, independently of official login. New replies remain unread; stale, offline and archived receipts cannot clear them. Official read sync is optional and cannot erase a gateway receipt. Recover a closed desktop management connection on refresh without replaying an operation or auto-starting the Agent. Rebuild with Go 1.27.3 and Electron 44.9.3; system Node is separate from the embedded runtime. Electron includes the verified blocked-CA-key patch but still reports embedded Node 24.22.0, not the complete Node 24.22.1 security release. Preserve settings, authorizations, IP policy and existing records.
